title: ngowf-world-heavyweight-championship

won.source: Won the tournament final over Joel Gutman on Must Bleed TV.

lost.source: No later document survives in the held record.

note: The fed's first World Heavyweight Champion.

title: ngowf-world-tag-team-championship

won.source: Awarded by forfeit on Monday Night Carnage after Mikey Dobson of Little & Large was jumped backstage.

lost.source: No later document survives in the held record.

note: The fed's first World Tag Team Champions, crowned without a match.

won.source: Won a twenty-man battle royal on the Monday Night Carnage premiere.

lost.source: Retained by disqualification against Bradley Fine on 28 November 1997; no later document survives.
